verses.greek: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ μὴ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τῶν προβάτων ἀλλὰ ἀναβαίνων ἀλλαχόθεν ἐκεῖνος κλέπτης ἐστὶν καὶ λῃστής·
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you the one not entering in through the door to the fold of the sheep but climbing up another way he a thief is and a robber
verses.dgt: “Truly, truly, I say to you: the one who does not enter the sheepfold through the door, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας ποιμήν ἐστιν τῶν προβάτων.
verses.literal: The one however entering in through the door shepherd is of the sheep.
verses.dgt: But the one who enters through the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

verses.greek: τούτῳ ὁ θυρωρὸς ἀνοίγει, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούει καὶ τὰ ἴδια πρόβατα φωνεῖ κατʼ ὄνομα καὶ ἐξάγει αὐτά.
verses.literal: To him the doorkeeper opens and the sheep to the voice of him listen and the his own sheep he shouts to by name and leads out them.
verses.dgt: The doorkeeper opens for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

verses.greek: ὅταν τὰ ἴδια πάντα ἐκβάλῃ, ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν πορεύεται, καὶ τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῷ ἀκολουθεῖ, ὅτι οἴδασιν τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: When the his own all he may bring out before them he goes and the sheep after him follow because they know the voice of him.
verses.dgt: When he has brought out all his own, he goes ahead of them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.

verses.greek: ἀλλοτρίῳ δὲ οὐ μὴ ἀκολουθήσουσιν ἀλλὰ φεύξονται ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασι τῶν ἀλλοτρίων τὴν φωνήν.
verses.literal: After a stranger however certainly not they will follow but will flee from him because not they know the of strangers the voice.
verses.dgt: But they will certainly not follow a stranger; instead, they will flee from him because they do not know the voice of strangers.”

verses.greek: ταύτην τὴν παροιμίαν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ἐκεῖνοι δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τίνα ἦν ἃ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς.
verses.literal: This the allegory spoke to them the Jesus they however not knew what it was that He was saying to them.
verses.dgt: Jesus spoke this figure of speech to them, but they did not understand what the things he was saying to them meant.

verses.greek: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα τῶν προβάτων.
verses.literal: Said therefore again to them the Jesus Amen Amen I say to you that I myself am the door of the sheep.
verses.dgt: So Jesus said to them again, “Truly, truly, I say to you: I am the door of the sheep.

verses.greek: πάντες ὅσοι ἦλθον πρὸ ἐμοῦ κλέπται εἰσὶν καὶ λῃσταί· ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἤκουσαν αὐτῶν τὰ πρόβατα.
verses.literal: All as many as came before Me thieves are and robbers but not did listen to them the sheep.
verses.dgt: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.

verses.greek: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα· διʼ ἐμοῦ ἐάν τις εἰσέλθῃ σωθήσεται καὶ εἰσελεύσεται καὶ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ νομὴν εὑρήσει.
verses.literal: I myself am the door through Me if anyone shall enter in he will be saved and he will go in and will go out and pasture will find.
verses.dgt: I am the door. If anyone enters through me, he will be saved, and he will go in and go out and find pasture.

verses.greek: ὁ κλέπτης οὐκ ἔρχεται εἰ μὴ ἵνα κλέψῃ καὶ θύσῃ καὶ ἀπολέσῃ· ἐγὼ ἦλθον ἵνα ζωὴν ἔχωσιν καὶ περισσὸν ἔχωσιν.
verses.literal: The thief not comes only except that he shall steal and shall kill and shall destroy I myself came that life they may have and excessive may have.
verses.dgt: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came so that they may have life and have it abundantly.

verses.greek: Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός· ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλὸς τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ τίθησιν ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων·
verses.literal: I myself am the shepherd the good The shepherd the good the life of Him lays down for the sheep.
verses.dgt: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

verses.greek: ὁ μισθωτὸς καὶ οὐκ ὢν ποιμήν, οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν τὰ πρόβατα ἴδια, θεωρεῖ τὸν λύκον ἐρχόμενον καὶ ἀφίησιν τὰ πρόβατα καὶ φεύγει— καὶ ὁ λύκος ἁρπάζει αὐτὰ καὶ σκορπίζει—
verses.literal: the hired servant however not being the shepherd whose not are the sheep his own he sees the wolf coming and he leaves the sheep and flees — and the wolf snatches them and scatters —.
verses.dgt: But the hired worker, who is not the shepherd and whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. Then the wolf snatches them and scatters them.

verses.greek: ὅτι μισθωτός ἐστιν καὶ οὐ μέλει αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν προβάτων.
verses.literal: because a hired servant he is and not he is himself concerned to him about the sheep.
verses.dgt: He flees because he is a hired worker and does not care about the sheep.

verses.greek: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός, καὶ γινώσκω τὰ ἐμὰ καὶ γινώσκουσί με τὰ ἐμά,
verses.literal: I myself am the shepherd the good and I know the My own and they know me those mine
verses.dgt: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and my own know me,

verses.greek: καθὼς γινώσκει με ὁ πατὴρ κἀγὼ γινώσκω τὸν πατέρα, καὶ τὴν ψυχήν μου τίθημι ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων.
verses.literal: Even as knows Me the Father I myself also know the Father and the life of Mine I lay down for the sheep.
verses.dgt: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father. And I lay down my life for the sheep.

verses.greek: καὶ ἄλλα πρόβατα ἔχω ἃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς αὐλῆς ταύτης· κἀκεῖνα δεῖ με ἀγαγεῖν, καὶ τῆς φωνῆς μου ἀκούσουσιν, καὶ γενήσονται μία ποίμνη, εἷς ποιμήν.
verses.literal: And other sheep I have which not are of the fold this those also it behooves Me to bring and to the voice of Mine they will listen and they will become one flock with one shepherd.
verses.dgt: I have other sheep that are not from this fold. I must bring them also, and they will listen to my voice, and they will become one flock with one shepherd.

verses.greek: διὰ τοῦτό με ὁ πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ ὅτι ἐγὼ τίθημι τὴν ψυχήν μου, ἵνα πάλιν λάβω αὐτήν.
verses.literal: Because of this Me the Father loves because I myself lay down the life of Mine that again I may take it.
verses.dgt: For this reason the Father loves me: because I lay down my life so that I may take it again.

verses.greek: οὐδεὶς αἴρει αὐτὴν ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ τίθημι αὐτὴν ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ. ἐξουσίαν ἔχω θεῖναι αὐτήν, καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἔχω πάλιν λαβεῖν αὐτήν· ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔλαβον παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου.
verses.literal: No one takes away it from Me but I myself lay down it of Myself. Authority I have to lay down it and authority I have again to take it This the commandment I received from the Father of Mine.
verses.dgt: No one takes it from me; I lay it down from myself. I have authority to lay it down, and I have authority to take it again. I received this command from my Father.”

verses.greek: Σχίσμα πάλιν ἐγένετο ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις διὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους.
verses.literal: Division again there was among the Jews on account of the words these.
verses.dgt: A division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

verses.greek: ἔλεγον δὲ πολλοὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν· Δαιμόνιον ἔχει καὶ μαίνεται· τί αὐτοῦ ἀκούετε;
verses.literal: Were saying now many of them A demon He has and is insane why to Him do you listen?
verses.dgt: Many of them were saying, “He has a demon and is insane. Why do you listen to him?”

verses.greek: ἄλλοι ἔλεγον· Ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα οὐκ ἔστιν δαιμονιζομένου· μὴ δαιμόνιον δύναται τυφλῶν ὀφθαλμοὺς ἀνοῖξαι;
verses.literal: Others were saying These the declarations not are those of one demonised Surely not a demon is able of the blind their eyes to open?
verses.dgt: Others were saying, “These are not the words of someone demon-possessed. A demon cannot open the eyes of the blind, can it?”

verses.greek: Ἐγένετο τότε τὰ ἐγκαίνια ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις· χειμὼν ἦν,
verses.literal: Took place at the time the Feast of Dedication at the Jerusalem winter it was
verses.dgt: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,

verses.greek: καὶ περιεπάτει ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐν τῇ στοᾷ τοῦ Σολομῶνος.
verses.literal: and was walking the Jesus in the temple in the porch the of Solomon.
verses.dgt: and Jesus was walking in the temple in Solomon’s colonnade.

verses.greek: ἐκύκλωσαν οὖν αὐτὸν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ· Ἕως πότε τὴν ψυχὴν ἡμῶν αἴρεις; εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστός, εἰπὲ ἡμῖν παρρησίᾳ.
verses.literal: Encircled therefore Him the Jews and they were saying to Him Until when the soul of us hold You in suspense? If You yourself are the Christ do tell us plainly.
verses.dgt: So the Jews surrounded him and were saying to him, “How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἶπον ὑμῖν καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε· τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρός μου ταῦτα μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ·
verses.literal: Answered them the Jesus I told you and not you believe. The works that I myself do in the name of the Father of Mine these bear witness concerning Me
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name testify about me.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε, ὅτι οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐκ τῶν προβάτων τῶν ἐμῶν.
verses.literal: But you yourselves not believe because not you are from among the sheep the of Mine
verses.dgt: But you do not believe, because you are not among my sheep.

verses.greek: τὰ πρόβατα τὰ ἐμὰ τῆς φωνῆς μου ἀκούουσιν, κἀγὼ γινώσκω αὐτά, καὶ ἀκολουθοῦσίν μοι,
verses.literal: The sheep the of Mine to the voice of Mine they listen and I myself know them and they follow Me
verses.dgt: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

verses.greek: κἀγὼ δίδωμι αὐτοῖς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀπόλωνται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, καὶ οὐχ ἁρπάσει τις αὐτὰ ἐκ τῆς χειρός μου.
verses.literal: and I myself give to them life eternal and certainly not shall they perish to the age and never will seize anyone them out of the hand of Me.
verses.dgt: I give them eternal life, and they will certainly never perish, and no one will seize them out of my hand.

verses.greek: ὁ πατήρ μου ὃ δέδωκέν μοι πάντων μεῖζων ἐστίν, καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται ἁρπάζειν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ πατρός.
verses.literal: The Father of Mine which has given them to Me than all greater is and no one is able to seize them out of the hand the Father
verses.dgt: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all, and no one can seize them out of the Father’s hand.

verses.greek: ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἕν ἐσμεν.
verses.literal: I myself and the Father one are.
verses.dgt: I and the Father are one.”

verses.greek: Ἐβάστασαν οὖν πάλιν λίθους οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἵνα λιθάσωσιν αὐτόν.
verses.literal: Took up therefore again stones the Jews that they may stone Him.
verses.dgt: Then the Jews again picked up stones in order to stone him.

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πολλὰ ἔργα καλὰ ἔδειξα ὑμῖν ἐκ τοῦ πατρός· διὰ ποῖον αὐτῶν ἔργον ἐμὲ λιθάζετε;
verses.literal: Answered them the Jesus Many works good I have shown you from the Father because of which of these work Me myself do you stone
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these works are you stoning me?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Περὶ καλοῦ ἔργου οὐ λιθάζομέν σε ἀλλὰ περὶ βλασφημίας, καὶ ὅτι σὺ ἄνθρωπος ὢν ποιεῖς σεαυτὸν θεόν.
verses.literal: Answered to Him the Jews For a good work not we do stone You but for blasphemy and because You yourself a man being make yourself God.
verses.dgt: The Jews answered him, “We are not stoning you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, though a man, make yourself God.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐκ ἔστιν γεγραμμένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὑμῶν ὅτι Ἐγὼ εἶπα· Θεοί ἐστε;
verses.literal: Answered to them the Jesus Surely it is written in the law of you that I myself said: gods you are’?
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “Is it not written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

verses.greek: εἰ ἐκείνους εἶπεν θεοὺς πρὸς οὓς ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ ἐγένετο, καὶ οὐ δύναται λυθῆναι ἡ γραφή,
verses.literal: If them he called gods to whom the word the of God came and not is able to be broken the Scripture
verses.dgt: If he called those people gods to whom the word of God came—and Scripture cannot be broken—

verses.greek: ὃν ὁ πατὴρ ἡγίασεν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Βλασφημεῖς, ὅτι εἶπον· Υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ εἰμι;
verses.literal: of Him whom the Father sanctified and He sent into the world you yourselves do say that You blaspheme because I said Son the of God I am’?
verses.dgt: do you say of the one whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You are blaspheming,’ because I said, ‘I am God’s Son’?

verses.greek: εἰ οὐ ποιῶ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρός μου, μὴ πιστεύετέ μοι·
verses.literal: If not I do the works of the Father of Mine then not do believe Me
verses.dgt: If I do not do the works of my Father, do not believe me.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ ποιῶ, κἂν ἐμοὶ μὴ πιστεύητε τοῖς ἔργοις πιστεύετε, ἵνα γνῶτε καὶ γινώσκητε ὅτι ἐν ἐμοὶ ὁ πατὴρ κἀγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρί.
verses.literal: If however I do even if Me myself not you shall believe in the works do believe so that you may know and may understand that in Me myself is the Father and I myself in the Father.
verses.dgt: But if I do them, even if you do not believe me, believe the works, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.”

verses.greek: ἐζήτουν οὖν πάλιν αὐτὸν πιάσαι· καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν.
verses.literal: They were seeking therefore again Him to seize but He went forth out of the hand of them
verses.dgt: Then they tried again to seize him, but he escaped from their hand.

verses.greek: Καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου εἰς τὸν τόπον ὅπου ἦν Ἰωάννης τὸ πρῶτον βαπτίζων, καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ.
verses.literal: And He departed again beyond the Jordan to the place where was John the at first baptizing And He stayed there.
verses.dgt: He went away again beyond the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

verses.greek: καὶ πολλοὶ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Ἰωάννης μὲν σημεῖον ἐποίησεν οὐδέν, πάντα δὲ ὅσα εἶπεν Ἰωάννης περὶ τούτου ἀληθῆ ἦν.
verses.literal: And many came to Him and were saying that John indeed sign did nothing everything however as much as said John about this man true was.
verses.dgt: Many came to him and were saying, “John did no sign, but everything John said about this man was true.”

verses.greek: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ.
verses.literal: And many believed in Him there.
verses.dgt: And many believed in him there.
